name: site shaping host

BASHY_PAIR_CODE.description: One-time pairing code from your cloudbox account (first start only).

SHAPING_SATELLITE.description: Your satellite to attach to (outpost satellite list).

SITE_AI_KEY.description: Key for the AI route in site.json (e.g. a GitHub token with models:read).

postStartCommand: bash -lc 'bashy --bashsharp bin/shaping-host.bsh up && bashy --bashsharp bin/website.bsh serve . --name ${SITE_APP_NAME:-site}'
